override_policy: User arguments override these settings; record effective values outside the target repository. Preserve mandatory stages. Budgets are soft; never truncate silently.

quick.native_checks: Existing fast lint/type/format checks; reuse valid same-snapshot test evidence or mark tests not run.
quick.verification: Verify all high-impact candidates and the leading candidates per dimension. List the rest as unverified.
quick.architecture: Trace one main product journey and its failure/cleanup path; assess all four required concerns.
quick.subjective_coverage: All generated dimensions and batches; no dimension pruning.

standard.native_checks: Existing lint/type/format checks, relevant tests and configured dependency checks when available.
standard.verification: Verify every candidate proposed for action; retain unverified backlog separately.
standard.architecture: Trace main journeys across boundaries, state owners, abstractions, error propagation and test seams.
standard.subjective_coverage: All generated dimensions and batches, with caller and test inspection.

deep.native_checks: Existing full local quality gates where safe; integration checks only with isolated fixtures and suitable authority.
deep.verification: Investigate every candidate, cross-module effects and representative counterexamples; disclose any unverified remainder.
deep.architecture: Trace product journeys, failure and concurrency paths, lifecycle ownership, public contracts and change history where available.
deep.subjective_coverage: All generated dimensions and batches with broader cross-module source and test coverage.
deep.challenge: Only unresolved high-impact disputes; deeper evidence gathering is not automatic escalation.
